title: Vice President of Quality Management, RN
text:
**Job Description**
Our client, an organization that provides comprehensive outpatient and inpatient mental health services, is hiring a
**Vice President of Quality Management, RN.**
The Vice President of Quality Management, RN, will provide executive leadership while remaining actively engaged in day-to-day quality operations. The role is designed for a hands-on, player-coach leader who can guide the quality team, strengthen performance, and contribute directly to departmental priorities.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and support the quality management function at both strategic and operational levels.
* Serve as an engaged player-coach who works directly with the team and remains involved in execution.
* Provide guidance, direction, and leadership to quality management professionals.
* Promote effective quality practices and continuous operational improvement.
* Represent the quality function with strong executive presence and sound professional judgment.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated leadership experience in quality management.
* Ability to operate as a hands-on leader while effectively coaching and developing a team.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership.
* Proven ability to work in the details while maintaining a strategic perspective.
* Excellent judgment, collaboration, communication, and organizational skills.
* Preferred educational background, required years of experience, certifications, travel expectations, and additional technical qualifications were not provided and should be confirmed before publication.
* Candidates with relevant industry experience and a record of leading quality improvement initiatives are encouraged to apply.

Some of the Benefits
 
 

* Competitive salary.
* Potential bonus opportunity.
